data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: pre-commit hook writes /tmp/sprint-merge-only-bypass-*.log on every bypass invocation, but end-session SKILL.md has no surveillance step that reads these logs to flag silent architectural bypass during a sprint. Proposed fix: add a 'Bypass Audit' phase to end-session SKILL.md that globs the logs, parses timestamps against session start, counts entries within the session window, emits an integrity-check warning + files a follow-up bug ticket if count >= threshold (default 3). Classification: MODERATE — single SKILL.md edit + need a test to verify the threshold check fires. Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
